# Template: CLI Tool

> Command-line applications.

## Questions

1. Language? (Python, Rust, Go, Node.js, etc.)
2. Arguments parsing? (argparse, clap, cobra, commander, etc.)
3. Config file format? (JSON, YAML, TOML, .env, none)

## Generated Files

- `spec.md` — commands, flags, config, output format
- `architecture.md` — entry point → commands → logic → output
- `tech-stack.md` — language, arg parser, config library
- `environment.md` — venv/init, install as editable/dev mode
